Hi, our engineering team just submitted a feature branch PR for the new payment processing module. The PR touches three files: a Python charge handler, a Node.js webhook endpoint, and a PHP invoice renderer. Before we merge this into develop, we need a thorough automated code review.

Please review the diff located at `finpay-app/pr_diff.txt` using the reviewer skill defined in `skill/SKILL.md` (which also references files under `skill/references/`). Save your complete review as a new file called `pr_review_report.md`.

We need the review to cover all three files, call out anything that could block the merge, and give us a clear go/no-go verdict. The team leads will read this report directly, so it needs to be detailed and actionable.
